overall_assessment: Reviewed all 21 courses (20 suspects and one random control): no personal-data leaks, course-content over-removal, text corruption or structure loss were found. All 19 name_like flags are false alarms involving headings, course/programme/organisation names or the legitimate Jeffrey Jerome Cohen reference; the removed flag correctly identifies a search-results placeholder rather than an actual course plan, and the random control has no defect. Semester-year lists and status notices are removed appropriately, but the admin_date flag is valid: one credit-overlap table retains the administrative date 1.8.25.

findings.description: The Dato cell in the credit-overlap table retains 1.8.25, an administrative effective date for the overlap rather than a content or government-document date. This violates the requirement to remove administrative dates and is the only confirmed defect among the 21 reviewed courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/anonymize.R: .anon_inn() removes semester lists and status notices but does not handle overlap-table dates. The general two-digit-year numeric-date rule in .anon_generic() requires leading zeros for single-digit days and months; the more permissive unpadded-date rule requires a four-digit year, so neither matches 1.8.25.
findings.suggested_fix: In .anon_inn(), identify the credit-overlap table under Emnet overlapper med or Professional overlap, locate its Dato/Date column from the tab-separated header, and clear cells containing valid d.m.yy or d.m.yyyy dates, including unpadded day/month values. Preserve course names, credits and row boundaries; add regression coverage for 1.8.25 and for government-document and reference dates outside this administrative column.
